b: It seems that Home Depot and Milwaukee Tool partnered on a limited edition hand tool gift set for the 2026 holiday season.
Milwaukee sent over a sample set – thank you, I appreciate it! – but I haven’t opened yet. I’ve been debating whether to keep it (I LOVE Milwaukee hand tools) or surprise someone else.
I’ve used nearly all of these tools before, and can enthusiastically recommend them. Some of my choices would differ, but these are solid tools.
Not to mince words, I’m not sure how I feel about the $99.97 price tag. It was discounted as part of a Home Depot online-only deal of the day recently, but was still over $90.
I need to price it out, so let’s look at that together. Here’s what you get, along with current pricing from Home Depot listings:
Milwaukee 14-in-1 Multi-Bit Screwdriver with Impact Duty Bits – $21.97
Milwaukee Clear Safety Glasses with Anti-Scratch Lenses – $6.97
If you were to buy everything separately, right now, the price would come out to around $106.
The box set is $99.97, and you do get the cute cardboard gift box.
It’s the holiday deals season. You can get a 2-pack of Milwaukee magnetic tape measures for $20, or a multi-bit screwdriver 2-pack for $20.
$100 is an okay value for what you get in the 7-piece holiday gift set. It’s a one-and-done package that’s sure to please.
Personally, I’d shop the holiday deals to put together a higher-valued Milwaukee tool kit with the same money. But that’s just me, I’ve got time to burn when it comes to tools.
As mentioned, I’m pretty stoked that Milwaukee sent me one of these tool kits. Whether, I keep it or pass it along, the tools are good quality and will bring someone joy.
I wouldn’t buy it for myself, as I would seek to stretch the same money a little further. But I can see this as being a good set to buy as a professional or family gift.
Maybe we’ll see more deal of the day discounts on it.
